summary: CytoMed Therapeutics Limited, a Singapore-domiciled Nasdaq-listed preclinical cell-therapy developer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 30, 2026 covering the period ended June 30, 2026, containing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements (Exhibit 99.1) and management's discussion and analysis (Exhibit 99.2). No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor or board recommendation is disclosed. The interim results show a loss of S$1.79 million (US$1.39 million) for the six months, or S$0.15 per share, versus S$2.25 million a year earlier, on revenue of S$157,289. This is a routine foreign-private-issuer interim reporting filing with no special-situation event; watch cash runway and financing risk instead.
